## Goal
Extend gate-draft so it validates draft review, triage, and repair artifacts as mechanical readiness checks.

## Acceptance Criteria
- gate-draft fails for missing required artifacts after non-PASS review verdicts.
- gate-draft fails for phase/source mismatch and item count mismatch.
- gate-draft fails for requires_user_decision triage items.
- gate-draft reports unresolved blocking findings without attempting design review.

## Implementation Notes
Mirror the spec-review-triage/spec-repair validation style and keep gate failure messages specific enough for one repair pass.

## Test Strategy
Gate tests cover missing artifacts, invalid JSON, mismatched counts, unresolved blocking findings, and valid PASS path.
